jobs.description: Purpose of your JobOur Science and Technology team is looking for a Modelling Scientist to advance data-driven drug development through cutting-edge computational approaches.In this role, you will apply mechanistic models, machine learning, and molecular simulations to predict the stability and behaviour of biopharmaceutical products. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate modelling into experimental workflows and support innovative, model-informed development strategies.Are you passionate about scientific modelling and pharmaceutical innovation?Join us and shape the future of computational drug development—apply today!Your Responsibility- Act as a scientific contributor in cross-functional research and development projects, supporting the integration of advanced modelling approaches into biopharmaceutical development.- Develop, validate, and apply advanced computational models to simulate the physical and chemicals stability, as well as the behaviour, of biopharmaceutical drug products.- Integrate experimental and structural data into predictive modelling frameworks.- Utilize a range of modelling techniques, including mechanistic models, machine learning approaches, and molecular simulations, to generate actionable scientific insights.- Contribute to the development of internal modelling platforms, tools, and workflows to enhance scalability and reproducibility.- Design and execute simulation studies to investigate formulations parameters, degradation pathways, and process related risks.- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including formulation scientists, analytical experts, and business developers to align modelling strategies with project objectives.- Analyse and interpret complex data to generate actionable insights.- Translate and present complex modelling outcomes into clear, impactful recommendations for internal stakeholders and project teams.- Ensure model quality through rigorous validation procedures and documentation, following internal standards and regulatory expectations where applicable.- Drive continuous innovation by exploring and implementing state-of-the-art computational approaches relevant to pharmaceutical formulation science.- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of developments in computational modelling, data science, and biopharmaceutical development to ensure the scientific relevance and competitiveness of modelling approaches.- Contribute to scientific excellence by co-authoring peer-reviewed publications.- Support regulatory submissions by providing modelling data and documentation as needed.What you need to succeed- Master’s degree or higher in Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field (PhD preferred)- Formal training or academic coursework in mechanistic modelling, machine learning, bioinformatics, or molecular dynamics is advantageous.- 2–5 years of experience in pharmaceutical research and computational modelling, ideally with exposure to protein- and nucleic acid-based therapeutics.- Strong programming and data analysis skills, with proficiency in tools such as Python, MATLAB, or R, and familiarity with modelling and simulation libraries.- Expertise in mechanistic modelling, machine learning, molecular modelling, or molecular dynamics simulations.- Solid understanding of biopharmaceutical products, including structure-function relationships, degradation mechanisms, and formulation challenges.- Experience in integrating computational models into experimental workflows and interdisciplinary project settings.- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities, with a track record of scientific contributions such as peer-reviewed publications or conference presentations.- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex modelling results into clear insights for diverse audiences.- Fluency in English, both written and spoken.- Collaborative and team-oriented mindset with a proactive and open approach to interdisciplinary work.- A passion for scientific innovation, curiosity, and a commitment to staying at the forefront of computational and pharmaceutical science.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Modellbildung, Simulation (IT)Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Molekularbiologie, Arzneimittelinformation, Galenik, Modellierungs- und Simulationssprache SystemC, Angewandte Informatik, Mathematik, KI-Detektoren, Data FabricExpertenkenntnisse: Programmiersprache R, Bioinformatik, Angewandte Mathematik, Biomathematik, Machine Learning, Laborarbeiten, Labortechnik, Datenvisualisierung, Data Science, Data Engineering, Quantitative ForschungsmethodeZwingend erforderlich: Arzneimittelentwicklung, Pharmazeutische Technologie, Programmiersprache Python, Forschung, Analysis

jobs.description: Company DescriptionWork with Us. Change the World.At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world's most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of nearly 51,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.Job DescriptionAECOM has a multidisciplinary team working with Data Centre clients across both Hyperscale and Colocation and Enterprise projects across Western Europe.This job opening focusses on the German Market, seeking someone with a strong Design Management background in the local DC sector.This will require deep engagement to materialize and to ensure and timely delivery, meeting the recurring clients’ deadlines, budget and requirements.The design manager identifies the right level and capability of resources to be deployed on the project. It is the design managers responsibility to ensure the right level of bidding and pricing of new opportunities ensuring they are delivered as sold fees and margins. Thus, implying Project Management capabilities.**Job Responsibilities:** - Design Management in a high paced project environment in the German market- Covering multidisciplinary cross regional teams of CSA & MEP- Assisting bids commercially and technically for multi-disciplinary opportunities with key clients- Ensuring all internal as well as local regulatory governance is followed: both at bid stage and throughout the delivery of projectsQualifications- Senior Multidisciplinary Design Manager (MEP / Architectural Background)- DC Experience in accountable DM position- Proficient in contractual German and English- Ability to manage a busy workload and deadlines- Excellent communication skills are essentialAdditional InformationWhy join us?You will love the freedom to bring your own ideas and vision to life, combining client management, project delivery, and team leadership. You will value working alongside colleagues with outstanding technical expertise in a collaborative, caring, and supportive team environment. We offer a flexible working environment, a competitive salary, and a culture that places safety, wellbeing, and professional development at the heart of everything we do.If you are looking to work for one of the world’s most trusted global environmental consulting firms and help shape a more sustainable future for Germany and beyond, the AECOM Germany team looks forward to welcoming you on board.Homeoffice:Umfang: Maximal 40%
